description: Read-only access to rank tracker configs and their latest results. With `trackerId`, returns the config plus the latest snapshot per keyword. Without it, lists all trackers in the project. FREE — reads stored MisarSEO state only, runs no SERP query and charges no credits. To trigger a new check, use the dashboard. A null position means THE DOMAIN WAS NOT FOUND WITHIN THE DEPTH SEARCHED. The response states that depth as a number — use THAT number, not the config's `serpDepth`, which is what was asked for and can be several times deeper than the search source reaches. Everything past the depth searched was not measured, so a null is neither a rank of zero nor proof the page stopped ranking — say 'not found in the top N' and give the N the response states. Device columns are printed only where this deployment measures desktop and mobile as separate searches; where it does not, the response says so and prints ONE position per keyword. Never report a mobile or desktop absence from a column the response did not print, and never infer one from the config's `devices` value. `previousPosition` is a roughly 7-day-old comparison point, and when no snapshot that old exists it falls back to the EARLIEST snapshot on record — so a 'was' figure can be much older than a week. Do not quote it as a week-over-week change without checking the tracker's history length.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

trackerId.description: Rank tracker config ID. If omitted, lists all rank trackers in the project.

name: get_rank_tracker
